exactBlockers.finding: Three of the eight open families are required by no D track in the 67: MO:cr145-form-petition-en, VA:cc-1203-form-en and VT:200-00631-form-en. Their jurisdictions do have D tracks, but those tracks bind to different families (MO CR-300/CR-360/GN-10, VA CC-1473/CC-1201, VT 200-00130/200-00132/600-00228). The corrections are still required — the families are open on independent review — but no track is currently waiting on them.
exactBlockers.question: Was each of these three built for a track outside the D 67, or is a relationship missing from the track map?
exactBlockers.owner: Terminal D relationship-metadata owner with Terminal A

exactBlockers.finding: D-FIX-4 is a defect in the SHARED fitter, not in two families. The review found it in VA CC-1203 and VT 200-00631 because those are the two it opened, but a fitter that reports a clean shrink while truncating a drawn value can have produced the same silent defect in any family the factory rendered.
exactBlockers.question: Once the fitter is corrected, which already-approved families need their rendered artifacts re-checked against the corrected fitter?
exactBlockers.owner: Terminal D remediation owner with the independent reviewer

exactBlockers.finding: 25 of the 67 tracks resolve no exact family relationship at all, and 104 pinned component relationships are unresolved.
